implementation: Xirrus WLAN Array - XS-3900, XS-3700, XS-3500
description: The Xirrus Wireless LAN Array represents the next generation in enterprise wireless LAN architecture - combining the functionality of a WLAN switch and Integrated Access Points (IAPs) in a single device. The WLAN Array delivers Gigabit-class Wi-Fi bandwidth to an extended coverage area simplifying the wireless LAN setup, deployment and management.
